description: Whole organisation (100+ people, multiple departments), shared memory, full governance. 22 questions, ~15 min to complete.

questions.prompt: What should I call this AugmentIQ setup? (e.g., 'acme-corp', 'globex-2026')
questions.why_we_ask: Used for the timeline prefix, config filename, and the organisation tag on every record.
Used in audit reports and DSR responses. May include spaces, capitalisation.

questions.prompt: Industry vertical? (helps the agent recommend compliance defaults)
questions.why_we_ask: Drives the compliance-pack recommendations. Healthcare → HIPAA. Finance → SOC2 + PCI-DSS. Government → ISO 27001 + custom. SaaS → SOC2. Manufacturing → ISO 27001.
questions.validation: one of: healthcare, finance, government, defense, saas, manufacturing, retail, logistics, education, other

questions.why_we_ask: Used to size crons, retention windows, and the audit log. Org-scale deployments are sized differently from department-scale.

questions.prompt: Which host agent is the primary?
questions.why_we_ask: Determines the cron registration format and the slash command dispatch.
questions.validation: one of: hermes, openclaw, claude_code, codex, cursor

questions.prompt: Which memory backend are you using?
questions.why_we_ask: For organisations, Custom (AugmentIQ+ MCP server) is the recommended choice — local-first, no vendor lock-in, tamper-evident audit. The AugmentIQ+ platform is the enterprise product.

options.label: mem0 — cloud alternative, requires trust in mem0's compliance posture

questions.prompt: Where is the AugmentIQ+ MCP server located?
questions.why_we_ask: The Skill launches the MCP server as a subprocess. Per Antigravity, the launch command is `docker run -i augmentiq-engine`. Override only if you've deployed the server elsewhere.
Drives the retention defaults, DSR workflow, and audit report content. For organisations, all 4 (GDPR, SOC2, HIPAA, ISO 27001) are commonly required. Override per your legal counsel's advice.
questions.validation: each entry one of: gdpr, soc2, hipaa, iso27001, pci_dss

questions.why_we_ask: Most org records are confidential by default. PII auto-upgrades to restricted. Per-record overrides are always possible.
questions.validation: one of: public, internal, confidential, restricted

questions.why_we_ask: When a DSR is fulfilled, the DPO is notified. Required for organisations with formal DPO roles (per GDPR Art. 37).

Defaults: 7 years for public/internal/confidential, 3 years for restricted. GDPR requires 'no longer than necessary' — set shorter for personal data. SOC2 / ISO 27001 may require 7 years for financial / quality records.
GDPR Art. 12 mandates 30 days. Some jurisdictions are tighter (e.g., California CCPA: 45 days). The Skill enforces this deadline; exceeding it is a violation.
For organisations, full cron set is required (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on-event).
All 7 triggers for organisations.
questions.validation: each entry one of: commit, decision, customer_interaction, incident, policy_change, hire, contract

questions.why_we_ask: For orgs, legacy ingest is typically part of the engagement. The agent will list the sources and route enterprise platforms (SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday) to customdev@upsurge.ae for paid migration.
questions.validation: each entry: source_id, source_type, source_category, location, classification_default, transfer_strategy

questions.prompt: Default batch size for nightly ingest batches?
questions.why_we_ask: For orgs, large batch is typical. Override per source if you have smaller sources.
questions.validation: one of: small_100, medium_1000, large_10000, xl_100000

questions.prompt: Custom migration engagement email (for enterprise platforms)?
questions.why_we_ask: When a source is enterprise_platform (SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday), the agent generates a draft email to this address with the source details.
For organisations, RBAC is required. Default roles: owner (full access), admin (all but destroy), manager (department scope), member (read + write own records), auditor (read only).

questions.prompt: Multi-agent federation? (Allow subagents for batch processing, large migrations, audit generation)
questions.why_we_ask: For orgs, multi-agent federation is recommended. Subagents are useful for: large legacy ingests (>10k items), quarterly audit generation, DSR fulfillment at scale.
pause_and_alert: stop writes, alert ops, resume when back. Recommended for orgs — silent data loss is unacceptable.

questions.prompt: Failover memory backend? (where to write if primary is down for >1 hour)
questions.why_we_ask: Optional. If set, AugmentIQ switches to this backend when the primary is unreachable for >1 hour. The failover backend is typically a degraded mode (read-only) until primary returns.
questions.validation: one of: mem0, hermes_native, or empty (no failover)

questions.prompt: Telemetry to AugmentIQ core team? (anonymous usage stats, error reports)
questions.why_we_ask: Default is no for organisations (data sovereignty). If yes, we collect: command counts, error rates, performance metrics. Never record content. Opt-in only.
